quests.title: Omni-Ubiquity Net

dialogue.t: Ugh, that Wakamurasaki... I shouldn't have let her know about Kageroumaru...
Oh, hello there, Traveler. Do you still remember the Ubiquity Net, by any chance?
After we settled the previous incident, I explained all that happened to a friend of mine.
Her name is Wakamurasaki, and she's... Well, she calls herself a "designer."
She was quite inspired by the manner in which you used the net.
So she's been badgering me this whole time to help her look up new techniques with which she can continue modifying the Ubiquity Net...
I couldn't deal with all that nagging, so I did find her something new in that ancient collection of mine...
If the fancy takes you, Traveler, go to her place. If I don't miss my guess, she's probably finished her modifications by now.
Well, that should certainly do it...
That's me! What do you need?

dialogue.sit: Well, I'm here about the Ubiquity Net...

dialogue.t: Oh, are you? ...Ohh, I remember now. You must be that Traveler! Sango told me about you.
The way in which you operated that Net was truly impressive. Inspiring, in fact!

dialogue.sit: I've heard that you've been modifying it.

dialogue.t: Aye, that's right! Hehe... Sango dug up an all-new Onmyou technique for me and all!
I used that technique to modify this net once again, and I name this new model the "Omni-Ubiquity Net"!
According to Sango, this technique is able to detain the essence of living creatures before using certain objects as media to recreate the shape of that living being.
She even says that the utmost achievement of such an Onmyoudou technique is to recreate a human essence!
Such essences can answer questions and will never lie.
I must say that such a technique would be of unbelievable help to a detective like Sango!
You know what? I actually think that's why she told me about that technique and allowed me to make changes to the net...
Ah, ah! But don't you go around telling anyone that. I'm only telling you this because you and Sango are friends, alright?
Um, not yet...
No matter how I modify it, this net can only be used to recreate the essences of small creatures. It has no effect on humans whatsoever.
You know what, Traveler? Take this net with you. Who knows, seeing you in action might give me some inspiration again!
Here, take it with you — and remember, it's the Omni-Ubiquity Net now, not just the Ubiquity Net!
Go on, then, go catch a few lil' animals to test it out!
If the fancy takes you, Traveler, go to her place. If I don't miss my guess, she's probably finished her modifications by now.
Go on, then, go catch a few lil' animals to test it out!
How did it go? Well?
Hmm... I suppose that was inevitable...
Like I said before, this technique can detain the essence of a small animal, but if you want to retain that essence and recreate that animal, you will need a separate medium.
I integrated those techniques into the Net, such that it is also the essence-retention device and the recreation medium.
Well, basically, each net can only be used once.
This is an issue that I haven't been able to solve yet, either. If the medium can't stand repeated use, the cost of this device will be way too high...
I'll continue doing research into this net and try to fix the problem as soon as possible.
If you still need Omni-Ubiquity Nets, you can come find me.
And uh... even though these nets can catch small animals, they're a bit of a fuss to put together...
So, next time you want one of these nets, you'll have to pay me a nominal fee.
Relax! You're Sango's friend, I won't charge you too much. You'll get a good rate, I promise!
Did you find Wakamurasaki?

dialogue.sit: So, here's the deal with the Omni-Ubiquity Net...

dialogue.t: "Omni-Ubiquity Net"... You know what? It's not a bad name. Still, that technique...

dialogue.sit: Can that technique really detain a human's essence?

dialogue.t: Uh, no. That's not possible.
There are only records of such an onmyoudou technique existing. Any practicum has long disappeared into the mists of time.
The technique that I taught Wakamurasaki can only do that for small animals.

dialogue.sit: Wait, then why didn't you tell her?

dialogue.t: Oh, that? I just wanted Wakamurasaki to help me spread a certain something around.
"Bantan Sango Detective Agency's president is currently asking someone to create a net using Kamuna Onmyoudou that can make people tell the truth."
The long-lost Kamuna Onmyoudou, the Bantan Sango Detective Agency, and a net that can indeed detain the essences of small creatures.
Put all three together, and you have an urban legend that both sounds impressive, and that actually has a grain of truth to it.
For most people, these urban legends are just little stories... But for criminals who already have the seed of fear in their hands, such tales are not so simple.

dialogue.sit: Ah, so that's how it is...

dialogue.t: The other side of it is... Well, Wakamurasaki was starting to get on my nerves with that whole "find me the strongest onmyoudou technique ever!" nonsense.
I told her many, many times that such things don't exist, but she wouldn't listen! So I had no choice but to give her *something* to work with so she'd get off my back.

dialogue.sit: What if Wakamurasaki doesn't tell anyone about this?

dialogue.t: Im-possible. She couldn't keep a secret to save her life. Trust me, I know her waaay too well...
Either way, thanks for making the trip on my behalf. Take this. Consider it payment for the errand run.
Archon, I hope she doesn't come to bother me again. I'm a detective you know? Not some onmyouji...

quests.description: Sango says that her friend would like to modify the Ubiquity Net…
